purpose: LRM 4.6.4.3: a noise_table over an array parameter takes the card's knots, not the declared defaults

oracle.derivation: Only noise: noise_table(tbl) on (out,0), tbl declared (1e3, 1e-18), (9e3, 9e-18) and set on the card to (1e3, 2e-18), (9e3, 18e-18). Z(out) = 1k||1k = 500 ohm. At 1k: 500*sqrt(2e-18) = 7.0710678118654755e-7; at 5k, halfway, 1e-17: 500*sqrt(1e-17) = 1.5811388300841898e-6. The declared defaults would give 5e-7 and 1.118e-6.
